notes.title: Server List Display Broken After UE 5.5 Update (SOLVED)
notes.content:
Breaking News!
Just a few hours ago, I discovered a very unpleasant issue — the server list display is currently not working. This came as a complete surprise to me, as I haven’t touched any code related to that functionality. After updating to Unreal Engine version 5.5, the online subsystem stopped functioning correctly and no longer displays created sessions properly.

Once again, I want to say a HUGE THANK YOU to Epic Games for breaking something critically important in the engine with every new update.

I’ve made a decision for myself — this will be the last engine version upgrade for this project. From now on, it will remain on version 5.5 for as long as technically possible. Version updates have started causing far too many problems.

Right now, I’m working on fixing the issue with the server list display. In PvE mode, when you host your own server, everything works as expected.

Stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: Important Notice: Review Keys Blocked Due to Misuse
notes.content:
Friends, I've received information about attempts to sell game keys that were distributed to reviewers. All such keys have now been blocked, and from this point on, the distribution of review keys will be strictly limited for two reasons:

- Attempts to sell them.
- A low amount of content and reviews compared to the number of keys distributed.
Anyone who wants to make a review or test the game can use the free playtest version or steam curator channel. In the future, I may create a separate demo version of the game for this purpose, if necessary.

Addition from April 26:
- Only the keys that were specifically distributed for reviewers for free to review the game have been revoked.
- This does not affect anyone who purchased the game through the Steam store.
- If you bought the game from a third-party marketplace and received a notification that your key was revoked, it means scammers sold you a copy of the game that was intended for review purposes only, not for sale.
    Advice: Never buy Steam games from third-party marketplaces.

notes.title: Update from April 24, 2025
notes.content:
- A small update to the AI bots that fixes some behavior bugs.

P.S. Why am I spending so much time working on bots instead of adding new features to the game? Since the player count is still relatively low, I want the bots to act as filler in the game world, and I want their behavior to closely mimic that of real players. Over time, as the number of online players grows, I’ll reduce the number of bots in the game - or remove them entirely, leaving them as an optional feature.

P.P.S. I’m now starting work on the experience and in-game currency system, which will allow players to upgrade different weapon branches and unlock new guns and upgrades. This will include a weapon progression tree and an in-game shop. As a reference, I’ll be using the system from World of Tanks for now.

notes.title: Update: Map Logic, Lighting Quality, and AI Behavior Fixes
notes.content:
- The build size has been optimized by implementing new logic for handling maps across different modes and time-of-day presets.

- The quality of the level's volumetric lighting has been improved.

- Fixed a bug where windows in buildings could not be shot through.

- Fixed a bug where AI bots couldn't see the player through a window.

notes.title: New step sounds & file chunks
notes.content:
- New footstep sounds
- A chunk system has been implemented for easier game updates

notes.title: Time-of-Day presets, weapon & AI-balance update
notes.content:
- Time-of-day presets (day/evening) have been added for Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes. These presets will be added to other modes and future maps as well. Players will be able to choose the atmosphere to their liking.

- Minor weapon rebalancing has been done.

- AI bot balance has been adjusted.

notes.title: Visual update
notes.content:
- Updated and improved environment lighting quality and shading.
- Reduced bots' field of view.
